name_reason: Compliant fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. '0b' is spell_id 0xB (11), a meaningful domain ID in the 00h-23h spell range (keep, not address residue). 'with_prefx' = 'with pre-effect/pre-fx', describing the SFX (id 2) + rising pre-cast effect that distinguishes this entry from the basic 0xA variant. Consistent with siblings fd2_cast_spell_0a_basic and fd2_cast_spell_0c_with_prefx in the same earthquake family. No address residue.
purpose: Spell dispatch handler for spell_id 0xB: plays a pre-cast SFX and rising pre-cast effect, then delegates to the earthquake worker.
logic_summary: Thin dispatch wrapper (entry 0xB of spell dispatch table @ 0x51D01). Plays generic cast SFX (id 2) via fd2_play_sfx_with_handle, runs fd2_play_rising_pre_cast_effect(caster, 0xF, 0xA) as the pre-effect, then invokes the earthquake worker with spell_id 0xB. In the binary the final call is a JMP into fd2_cast_spell_0a_basic's shared tail (after pushing 2 args + spell_id 0xB), which performs PUSH caster + CALL fd2_cast_earthquake_spell_with_screen_shake + cleanup + RET; src renders this functionally-equivalent shared tail as a direct call to fd2_cast_earthquake_spell_with_screen_shake(caster, 0xb, n_tgt, tgt_arr).
signature: void fd2_cast_spell_0b_with_prefx(int caster, int n_tgt, uint8 *tgt_arr)

params.name: caster
params.semantics: Caster unit id; forwarded to pre-cast effect and the earthquake worker.
params.reason: Descriptive, no address residue; matches src declaration. (Ghidra-side name caster_unit_id is also descriptive.)

params.name: n_tgt
params.semantics: Number of targets; passed through to the earthquake worker.
params.reason: Descriptive abbreviation of num_targets, no address residue; matches src declaration.

params.name: tgt_arr
params.semantics: Pointer to the target unit-id array; passed through to the earthquake worker.
params.reason: Descriptive abbreviation of target_id_array, no address residue; matches src declaration.

returns.semantics: No meaningful return value; dispatch handler called for its side effects (SFX + pre-effect + earthquake spell execution).

comment_original_issue: Function had no dedicated comment block, only the family-level header '=== Earthquake family (id 0xA-0xC) ===' which does not explain how this entry differs from the basic 0xA variant.
notes: src expresses the binary's JMP-to-shared-tail (into fd2_cast_spell_0a_basic @ 0x2153B) as a direct, functionally-equivalent call to fd2_cast_earthquake_spell_with_screen_shake; this is an established equivalence already documented in both plates, not a logic discrepancy. Sibling fd2_cast_spell_0c_with_prefx @ 0x21A9E follows the identical shape with pre-effect params {0x1E,0x10} and spell_id 0xC. Ghidra plate already accurately documents the SFX id, rising pre-cast params, shared-tail JMP, and net worker call; consistent with refined understanding so left unchanged.
